prerequisites: Cutting of metals and Machine tools
syllabus_topics: Technical and economical principles in technological process design for manufacturing and assembly
Basic rules and stages in building the structure of the technological process
Precision, productivity, and cost assurance of the designed technological processes
Technological equipment for machining and assembly of parts
Electro-physical and electro-chemical methods of manufacturing
assessment_rules: Each student may choose to take two tests in order to be exempt from the exam. The average grade from both tests equals an exam grade. Students are allowed to take the exam after their semester is certified, which happens if the student has attended classes regularly and submitted reports. The exam begins with a written part answering two questions and finishes with their discussion.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
